C0420.title: Selling Ticket-Snatching Tools Is Illegal! Suspect Arrested!
C0420.summary: In October 2024, Taiyuan police cracked a case involving illegal ticket-snatching tools. The suspect, Miao, sold plug-in programs via short-video platforms for prices ranging from 268 to 888 yuan. The tools allegedly tampered with ticketing-platform passcodes and helped users, including fans and scalpers, gain earlier access through official ticketing channels. Miao allegedly made more than 50,000 yuan in illegal gains.
